about.title: Benicia Car Accident Claims
about.longDescription: Benicia's mix of highway commuters and local traffic on E 2nd Street and Lake Herman Road means collisions happen in a variety of settings, from fast-moving freeway merges on I-780 and I-680 to slower intersection crashes downtown. Recent figures show 89 injury collisions and 115 people hurt in a single year, with crashes clustering on Friday afternoons as commuters and weekend traffic overlap. If you were injured, the choices you make in the first days matter: photographing the scene, getting medical care, and being careful about what you say to an insurance adjuster. LawProactive doesn't handle your claim directly — we're a free service that connects you with an independent personal injury attorney working on contingency, meaning there's no fee unless you recover compensation. Our goal is simply to help you find someone who can look at your situation and explain your options, without pressure or upfront cost.

whyChoose.title: Why Talk to an Attorney Before the Insurer

items.title: California's Clock Is Running
items.desc: You generally have two years from the crash to file a lawsuit, but if a government entity (like a city road defect) is involved, that window can shrink to as little as six months. Talking to an attorney early helps make sure a deadline doesn't quietly pass you by.

items.title: Comparative Fault Can Work Against You
items.desc: California allows recovery even if you're partly at fault, but your share of fault reduces what you can collect. Anything you say to the other driver's insurer — especially a recorded statement — can be used to shift more blame onto you.

items.title: No Cap on What You Can Seek
items.desc: California doesn't limit non-economic damages like pain and suffering in most car accident cases. An attorney can help make sure evidence of your injuries and their impact is properly preserved and presented, not just the property damage numbers.

items.question: Should I give a recorded statement to the other driver's insurance company?
items.answer: It's generally best to avoid giving a recorded statement before speaking with an attorney. Insurance adjusters are trained to ask questions that can be used to minimize your claim or shift fault onto you. An independent attorney can advise you on what, if anything, you're required to share.

items.question: How long do I have to file a claim after a Benicia car accident?
items.answer: In most car accident cases in California, you have two years from the date of the crash to file a lawsuit. If your crash involved a government-owned road or vehicle, such as certain stretches near Lake Herman Road, that deadline can be as short as six months, so it's important to act promptly.

items.question: What if the crash happened on I-780 or I-680 during heavy commute traffic?
items.answer: Crashes on high-volume corridors like I-780 and I-680 often involve multiple vehicles and disputed accounts of what happened. An attorney can help gather traffic camera footage, witness statements, and other evidence before it disappears, which is especially important on busy freeway stretches.

items.question: Does it cost anything to use LawProactive?
items.answer: No. LawProactive is a free service that connects injured people with independent attorneys. Attorneys in our network work on contingency, meaning they only get paid if you recover compensation.
